glm_normalization_atomic_sufficiency.evidence: parse_scores uses set(got)==set(labels) and len equality; calling it with labels=['X'] accepts a single-row {"scores":[{"label":"X",...}]} or bare-array response. The two observed GLM failure classes (partial-label, self-atomized multi-block) are induced by multi-candidate prompting and vanish under one-candidate-per-call. The existing test_wrapped_array_and_literal_newlines already exercises the single-label path.
